description: Read spaces from their files under TaskForge/Settings/spaces/ (so a space the app has not opened yet shows too). Without `space`: every space with id, slug, name, display order, hidden and its sections. With `space` (id, slug or name): that space's whole document as stored, plus `notes` naming anything the validator flags. Read-only.

space.description:
The space (id, slug or name). Omit to list every space file: id,
slug, name, display order, hidden and sections.

name: get_space
